details:
Based on the recent blog post, it seems like VRChat wants to implement other methods of age assurance, including age estimation technology.

This is a horrible idea, communities rely on the fact that ID verification is certain. The current system prevents the same ID from being used on multiple accounts and serves as a good barrier that age verified accounts are adults.

Age estimation techniques, are inherently flawed as they are in-fact estimations, and can easily be fooled. When Discord introduced age estimation through facial analysos, it was easily fooled by people doing things like using Dr. Breen's model in GMod to pass age verification.

https://youtube.com/shorts/5-HTXXQxHKQ

I'm not sure if facial age estimation is one of the technologies being used, but it is by far the most common one that other companies do use, so I can assume that's one of the primary ones being considered. 

We risk going back to the era where giving your government ID to somebody over Discord was the way you verified your age in groups. The new system has mostly displaced this (and for good reason), and has allowed for mature communities to flourish.
title: Stick to ID verification, don't move forward with Age Estimation technologies
